body:
Track 5 follow-up to `simdesign-processcover` (its first next step): coverage of a bracket family weighted by arm volume instead of counted equally. Mass weighting nearly doubles FDM's loaded coverage (0.30 to 0.58), flips the laser-versus-CNC order, and changes the exhaustive machine choice at budgets 600–800 (one seed). Stylised, assumed rules/prices; 8 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
